column1: # SoN::Verify's counts per chalk graph, per rule: the `@` lines of
# `tools/wire-verify.pl --tsv --chalk DIR` (wire v2; until stage 6 also wire 1: chalk2), compiled
# under PERL_HASH_SEED=0 PERL_PERTURB_KEYS=0. Each line is SOURCE, @GRAPH, rule=n,... (the
# most one wire counts for that graph; empty for a clean one). A graph's file-level code is
# named by its wire (`Chalk/Foo:main::__PROGRAM__`). t/wire-verify-ratchet.t fails if a
# graph recorded here rises in any rule; a graph not here is printed, not held (perigrin,
# 2026-11-21). Re-record at the chalk commit a chalk branch merges at.
# 2026-11-21: recorded at chalk 45a1b8d5 with producer 9c7a3ba. Its totals are the chalk
# and chalk2 rows t/data/wire-verify-baseline.tsv held until then, row for row.
# 2026-11-21 (merge of stages 2+3): re-recorded at chalk eef945c6 (v2-int) with producer
# 77c664b, from the gate run's wires. Against the 45a1b8d5 record no graph rose; 244 graphs
# were new (17 with violations: WireUpgrade, Node::mem_in/mem_out, Assign::record and their
# kin). Totals: chalk memory-order-disagrees 295, read-unversioned:field 3814, through-ref
# copy fix and stage 2), version-off-chain 646, phi:memory-as-value 0 (25).
# 2026-11-21 (wire v2 stage 4, branch v2-s4): re-recorded at chalk 1eaafd8a with producer
# 24ccba5. No graph rose; 118 fell, all chalk2: version-off-chain 646 -> 0 (MakeCell placed),
# an endless loop in an arm). One anon sub renamed by its line (Builder::alias_saves).
# 2026-11-21 (wire v2 stage 6, branch v2-s6): re-recorded at chalk 5284360b with producer
# 785135c (the gate run's wires; the four that hold Lower.pm and Builder/Variables.pm compiled
